Adaptive Force in WR: 1 pt = 0.5 bonus AD or 1 AP.

gold_reference_items.name: Boots of Speed
gold_reference_items.notes: Wiki confirmed: 400g cost, 280g sell, +25 MS. Gold value of MS derived from Boots (≈25g per MS point using gold_value/stats, but cost-basis = 16g). Cost analysis on wiki states gold value = 625g (using 25g per MS point).

ability_haste.reference_item: Sapphire Crystal (~150g for 5 AH portion, estimated)

armor.notes: Works identically for negative armor (damage amplification).

magic_resist.notes: Works identically for negative MR (damage amplification).

physical.example: 2000 HP + 100 armor = 4000 effective HP vs physical
physical.notes: Each point of armor = 1% more effective HP vs physical.

magic.example: 2000 HP + 100 MR = 4000 effective HP vs magic

order_of_operations: 2. Percentage armor/MR reduction (e.g., Black Cleaver stacks)
3. Percentage armor/MR penetration (e.g., Lord Dominik's Regards, Void Staff)
4. Flat armor/MR penetration (e.g., Serrated Dirk, Sorcerer's Shoes equivalent)
penetration.notes: Penetration cannot reduce below 0 (floor at 0). Reduction CAN go below 0 (amplifies damage).

auto_attack_dps.notes: WR base crit damage = 175% (+75% bonus). IE increases crit damage.

attacks_per_second.notes: WR attack speed cap = 2.5 (can be exceeded with Lethal Tempo at max stacks).

ability_haste.notes: AH stacks linearly (each point gives equal value). CDR has diminishing returns.

gold_efficiency.example: Boots of Speed: (25 MS × 25g) / 400g = 625 / 400 = 156.25% gold efficient
gold_efficiency.notes: Passives and actives are NOT included in gold efficiency calculation. Items with strong passives may appear gold-inefficient but are still powerful.

tenacity.notes: Multiplicative stacking means diminishing returns. Does NOT reduce Airborne or Suppression duration.

calculation: 2. Add all flat bonuses (boots, items, abilities)
3. Multiply by (1 + sum of all % bonuses)
movement_speed.notes: Slows reduce the final MS value. Multiple slows: strongest applies fully, rest at 30% effectiveness.

adaptive_force.formula: 1 Adaptive Force = 0.5 bonus AD OR 1 AP
adaptive_force.determination: Based on champion's adaptive type (most scaling ratios determine this)
adaptive_force.notes: WR-specific: differs from PC LoL values.

level_scaling.notes: WR has 15 levels (not 18 like PC LoL). Growth is linear per level.

critical_strike.notes: WR crit damage is 175% base (PC LoL is also 175%). Infinity Edge adds +40%.

grievous_wounds.notes: Does not stack — highest value applies.

passive_gold_generation.notes: WR has accelerated gold income compared to PC LoL.

minion_gold.notes: Approximate values — WR minion gold differs from PC LoL. Last-hitting grants full gold; nearby grants partial.

champion_kills.assist_gold: variable (50% of kill gold for 1 assist, split among multiple)
champion_kills.notes: Bounty increases with consecutive kills without dying.

turret_gold.notes: WR turret gold values differ from PC LoL.

jungle_camps.notes: Smite passive (Conservation) adds additional gold. Exact values vary by camp type.

sell_ratio.notes: All items sell for 70% of their total cost (confirmed from Boots: 400 × 0.70 = 280).

support_items.notes: Support items generate bonus gold through their passives and upgrade to ward-providing items.

early_game.description: Laning phase, first turrets, early ganks

late_game.description: Baron fights, elder dragon, full builds, game-deciding plays

effects.chemtech_soul: Damage amp while low HP + brief revive

soul.notes: Only one team can get soul. After soul, Elder Dragon spawns.

individual_buffs.ocean: +2% missing HP regen per 5s per drake

rift_herald.reward: Eye of the Herald — summon to charge turrets
rift_herald.notes: Only spawns twice maximum (at 6:00 and if killed early enough before 10:00).

buff_effects.minion_empowerment: Nearby minions gain increased stats (HP, damage, resistance)

baron_nashor.notes: Baron buff is the most powerful neutral objective buff. Enables siege and base push.

elder_dragon.spawn_condition: After a team claims Dragon Soul (4th dragon)

buff_effects.elder_immolation: Damaging an enemy champion at low HP executes them
buff_effects.burn_damage: Attacks and abilities deal bonus true damage as a burn

elder_dragon.notes: Elder Dragon buff is extremely powerful — team with it should force a fight.

turret_stats.notes: Turrets gain resistances over time. Nexus in WR can attack champions directly (no Nexus turrets).

champion_stats.notes: WR has 15 levels. Stats scale linearly per level. Some champions have different growth rates.
